skinCatalogue.name: Requiem Vesperis
skinCatalogue.description: Robes for Vespers specially made for Lemuen. May her pure light be as the twilight stars, granting all a blessing of peace amidst the interplay of light and shadow.

skinCatalogue.name: As Clear As Crystal
skinCatalogue.description: Necrass's dress for the musical. The inner lining bedecked with stars is the abyss of the past, the radiant outer surface the resolute present. Through crystal and steel, her will carries on.

skinCatalogue.name: Unstained Unshaken
skinCatalogue.description: Outlined in sharp lines and painted in cold tones, revealing the wearer's pioneering, problem-smashing fearlessness in full color.

skinCatalogue.name: Blooming Reverie
skinCatalogue.description: Satin dress Nymph chose for herself. The fluttering hem complements her flower-shaped updo, turning her into an elegant fairy dancing in the garden, lively and graceful.

skinCatalogue.name: Prelude to Transcendence
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Surtr wore to the theater. The fiery train symbolizing the flame of her soul, the gold-trimmed white performing the song of her mind.

skinCatalogue.name: In Contemplation of Life
skinCatalogue.description: 埃癸斯在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。修士的生活漫长平静，她观察植物的生长，寻觅一个未知问题为何的答案。

skinCatalogue.id: Koromaru / Over the City of Sweetness
skinCatalogue.name: Over the City of Sweetness
skinCatalogue.description: 虎狼丸在拉特兰时常穿着的服装。全城的甜品都飞上了天空，围绕着虎狼丸，殷切盼望他能尝上一口——什么，是梦？！

skinCatalogue.id: Makoto Yuki / In Witness of Glory
skinCatalogue.name: In Witness of Glory
skinCatalogue.description: 结城理在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。拒绝审判的执行者走出殿堂，等待他的是自由与真正的荣光.

skinCatalogue.id: Yukari Takeba / In Vigil of Dawn and Dusk
skinCatalogue.name: In Vigil of Dawn and Dusk
skinCatalogue.description: 岳羽由加莉在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。戍卫队员在白墙顶端远眺，安宁的暮色是她在漫长旅途后获得的奖赏。

skinCatalogue.name: Bedtime Story
skinCatalogue.description: Brigid's 'housewear' she chose for herself. Even if there's rarely a warm room to enjoy oneself in, it can still grant the hasty a moment of calm.

skinCatalogue.id: Matsukiri / Glow of the Golden Dusk
skinCatalogue.name: Glow of the Golden Dusk
skinCatalogue.description: 森内彻获得了无数财富，却最终步入孤独时的着装。修身西装搭配金紫色内衬的外套，虽然华贵气质外显，却藏不住内心的疲惫。

skinCatalogue.name: The Heavenly Bridge
skinCatalogue.description: 炎国匠人为云迹特别设计的服饰，宽松款裙装搭配纨扇和飘带，让她无论在哪一片天空中都能怡然自在。

skinCatalogue.id: Leizi the Thunderbringer / The Bloodwing Rose
skinCatalogue.name: The Bloodwing Rose
skinCatalogue.description: Leizi's character in 'Dark Age of Terra'. Amidst bloodwing's roar, twisting, thorned peals of thunder descend. Of all the challenges the adventurers have faced, she is the prickliest by far.

skinCatalogue.name: The Next Side Quest
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Papyrus picked during character creation in 'Dark Age of Terra'. She never stops running about the game, recording all the stories she can find in this new world.

skinCatalogue.name: Lorem Ipsum
skinCatalogue.description: Raidian's character in the alpha test of 'Dark Age of Terra'. The witch floats leisurely past the valley, her giant unrendered companion the incarnation of her awesome might.

skinCatalogue.id: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska / One More Story
skinCatalogue.name: One More Story
skinCatalogue.description: 阿黛尔最喜欢的一套便服。柔软舒适的居家服和绵绒拖鞋所带来的令人安心的触感，能唤起她最珍视的回忆。

skinCatalogue.id: Hoshiguma the Breacher / An Ultimate Flash
skinCatalogue.name: An Ultimate Flash
skinCatalogue.description: 为能在街头一扫邪气的凛然之人所设计的服饰。镇邪符纸在蓝焰的光芒下更加显眼，映照出她快意无畏的鬼族英姿。

skinCatalogue.name: Leisurely Snapshot
skinCatalogue.description: 绮良前往御机城街头游玩时的着装。舒适的针织背心，吸睛的迷你裙，还有可爱的多彩发饰，这张快照一定大受好评。

skinCatalogue.name: Refreshing Setting
skinCatalogue.description: 蒂比参加迷你剧演出时的着装。清凉的夏装，附带一顶带着阳光味道的草帽，让镜头捕捉下少女最自然的姿态。

skinCatalogue.name: The Underfur Soiree
skinCatalogue.description: Miss.Christine出席晚间舞会时的装扮。朦胧轻纱搭配金色星芒挂饰，将其优雅慵懒的气质展露无遗。

skinCatalogue.name: Ribbons of Promise
skinCatalogue.description: Dress Beanstalk wore to the holiday party. A trailing dress of pure white is punctuated by a beautiful red, the fluttering ribbons highlighting the girl's vibrant charm.

skinCatalogue.name: Half-sweet Strawberry
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Grace wears while making holiday-appropriate sweets. A simple apron meets a clash of bold black against daring red, proof that there is no contradiction between reserved expression and sincere intent.

skinCatalogue.name: Hazy Jade
skinCatalogue.description: The painter of a thousand forms, wrapped in jade silk. The soul who sculpts ink into shape, entwined in kohl silk. The gauze stretches out before her, serving as her infinite canvas.

skinCatalogue.name: A Gallant Dream
skinCatalogue.description: Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.

skinCatalogue.name: An Opera of Flowers
skinCatalogue.description: Costume Philae wore while taking part in a traditional Yanese opera. A pale pink robe boasts sleeves of pure white, drawing in even graceful butterflies, who flutter about and rest by her side.

skinCatalogue.name: By the Lamplight
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.

skinCatalogue.name: Clear Morning View
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.

skinCatalogue.name: Holiday HD59
skinCatalogue.description: 舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flower FA240
skinCatalogue.description: 参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

skinCatalogue.id: Pramanix the Prerita / Hymn to Sunbreak
skinCatalogue.name: Hymn to Sunbreak
skinCatalogue.description: 笼罩在时光之上的层层阴云已然破开，装饰着晨星的披风内衬象征着得到净化的天际，而她佩戴的头饰绽放出了灿然的曙光。

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flower FA098
skinCatalogue.description: 参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

skinCatalogue.name: Relaxing Trip
skinCatalogue.description: Mark monsters, fortresses, and treasures on the map. Bring along your beloved dolls, a warm drink, and a cheerful mood. Come on, this is what it means to start a trip.

skinCatalogue.name: Forever Together
skinCatalogue.description: Black tea, lemon, colorful little sweets, and lots of soft, friendly companions. Forget stiff manners and anything that ties you down, and just lie back. Your friends' warm, welcoming arms are always there to embrace you.

skinCatalogue.name: Spring in Her Lens
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Xingzhu wore to her nutritional science course graduation ceremony. With a billowing deep blue robe paired with a lilac Yanese satin jacket, she is ready for the lens to capture her smile

skinCatalogue.name: Kindness and Strength
skinCatalogue.description: 她们都有软弱、害怕的时候，但是她们最终一定会挺身而出，为了重要之人付出自己的全部。

skinCatalogue.name: Knowledge and Magic
skinCatalogue.description: 深夜之时，她们还在知识的魔法世界中遨游。她们背负起应尽的责任，为了自己，也为了身边的人。

skinCatalogue.name: Honesty and Sincerity
skinCatalogue.description: 她们热情又可靠，像阳光下散发清香气味的苹果一样，时刻用笑容感染他人，给予大家勇气。

skinCatalogue.id: Blaze the Igniting Spark / Homecoming Night
skinCatalogue.name: Homecoming Night
skinCatalogue.description: Made from multiple layers of multifunctional materials. A light down coat to keep warm, a silver coating to ward off rain and wear. Perfect for both lounging at home and riding a steed of steel.

skinCatalogue.name: Dazzling Blue
skinCatalogue.description: A brilliant sapphire-blue velvet jacket paired with a form-fitting satin bodysuit keeps the wearer warm while showing off their confidence, turning them into the most dazzling star under the spotlight.

skinCatalogue.name: Scent of the Wild
skinCatalogue.description: 以炎国产出的绸缎制成的传统踏青服装。在寒冷北地长大的人，也能感受到仲夏云雾的温暖氛围。

skinCatalogue.name: The Starting Point
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Rose Salt wears while playing an adventure game. Carefree, she sits in front of the game console, slipping on her headphones. She's ready to loot hoards of treasure in the realm of fantasy.

skinCatalogue.name: The Bamboo Spiritualist
skinCatalogue.description: 由异国国主的礼服微调而成的着装。无需神秘的力量，泡普卡在经历时光的洗礼之后，逐渐有了新的改变。

skinCatalogue.id: Rhodes Island Recon / Camping Time Nya
skinCatalogue.name: Camping Time Nya
skinCatalogue.description: 为喜欢在山野林间活动的隐秘队量身定做的服装，活动性和透气性极佳。

skinCatalogue.name: The Enigma of Roses
skinCatalogue.description: 刺玫为电玩展的参展游戏《翡绿迷宫》拍摄海报时的着装。她所扮演的公主完成了授剑礼，蔷薇骑士自此拥有了一颗翡绿之心。

skinCatalogue.name: Out of Focus
skinCatalogue.description: 忍冬于叙拉古观看歌剧时的穿着。新型的合成面料在闪光灯下呈现耀眼的光泽，从各个角度反射出相似却不同的色彩。

skinCatalogue.name: Caelum Aeternum
skinCatalogue.description: 斗争血脉系列/天穹肇始。危难与困境从来都不会只停留在某个瞬间，真正的卫士守护着永恒交替的昼夜，一刻不休。信仰搅拌机，正为此而生。

skinCatalogue.id: Fang the Fire-Sharpened / A Pure Pianissimo
skinCatalogue.name: A Pure Pianissimo
skinCatalogue.description: The black-and-white performance wear is outlined with neat contours. It is a design Fang is fond of, a symbol of the festive melody she is about to compose.

skinCatalogue.id: Reed the Flame Shadow / Glowing Flame in the Night
skinCatalogue.name: Glowing Flame in the Night
skinCatalogue.description: Don a white sweater and thick boots, drape yourself in a red cloak, heft up bundles of presents and brightness, then step into the tranquil night sky.

skinCatalogue.name: The Dark Night Terminator
skinCatalogue.description: Crownslayer's iteration from decision point S/5258902. Dark clothes for an assassin. She grips her blade, determined to bring an end to the darkest corners of the city with her own hands.

skinCatalogue.id: Exusiai the New Covenant / The Legend Seeker
skinCatalogue.name: The Legend Seeker
skinCatalogue.description: 新约能天使在决策F/3019226中的迭代。传说已经变成众人口中的笑谈，只有红披风的吟游诗人，不曾停下追寻真实的脚步。

skinCatalogue.name: Purification of The Past
skinCatalogue.description: 一切历史都逃不过变为云烟的宿命，过去的千百年月都化作一抔泥土，聆音倚靠在被遗忘的水边，只愿涤净所有过往的喧嚣。

skinCatalogue.name: Stranded In Utopia
skinCatalogue.description: 遥在决策F/3019226中的迭代。跟随金鳞的指引，朝手鞠歌响起的方向前进，终于得见理想乡最深处，静待着来者的公主。

skinCatalogue.name: Sharpened Blades
skinCatalogue.description: Mon3tr在经历最重要的重逢后换上的新制服。再次突破进化与重构的理论界限，重新定义锐利与强韧的最高水平。

skinCatalogue.name: The Spirit-Farer
skinCatalogue.description: 诺威尔在决策F/3019226中的迭代。微光中的坟茔间，渡灵师立在黄昏时的木桥上，万灵都将受他指引踏入新的轮回。

skinCatalogue.name: Condolence
skinCatalogue.description: Attire worn by Civilight Eterna during her Deep Dive into Theresa 's data. Through the veil of time, she spots memories sealed by the dead.

skinCatalogue.name: Ritual of Immortality
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Ho'olheyak wore while touring the ruins. Under a loose coat lies an exceedingly-modern black dress, making clear that her purpose here is not to explore the past, but to sneer at its passing.

skinCatalogue.name: Unruly Humbleness
skinCatalogue.description: Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.

skinCatalogue.name: Glorious Path
skinCatalogue.description: Ceremonial clothes worn by Vina Victoria. The natural combination of black and white is contrasted with golden ornamentation, granting the wearer majesty and unbridled charm.

skinCatalogue.name: Biochemical Submergence
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit of the detective who snuck into the Hospital of Horror. Falling into a mysterious liquid, his back laden with a biochemical tank that may serve as key evidence. Can he uncover the terrifying truth?

skinCatalogue.name: The Nursing Home Creepshow
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit of the Dark Forest's therapist in the story. Holding poison in her right hand, her fingertips curled towards her subtle smile, making others wonder if those heavy chains are of any use.

skinCatalogue.name: Under Surgical Lights
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit of the doctor from the Hospital of Horror in the story. With bloodstained bandages and a wrapped-up mannequin, the mad doctor picks up his scalpel, searching for the secrets of the human body beyond ethical reach.

skinCatalogue.name: The Chainsaw Nurse
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit of the nurse from the Hospital of Horror in the story. Her gigantic chainsaw and conspicuous sutures are proof enough that she, the first masterpiece, lives on to this very day.

skinCatalogue.id: Executor the Ex Foedere / The Train Runner
skinCatalogue.name: The Train Runner
skinCatalogue.description: As a child, dressed in pristine clothes, he too chased the shadows of trains out of curiosity. Now, stepping onto exotic platforms, his goals are far clearer.

skinCatalogue.name: Fluffy Little Witch
skinCatalogue.description: Perhaps every girl has dreamed of it—raising a parasol, donning a top hat, letting her magic dance across the night sky. She tells her fluffy friends the moment for dreams to come true is here.

skinCatalogue.name: Autumn Shadow
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Figurino made himself from Yanese materials after talking to local craftsmen. The craftsmen sent him some shadow puppets, and ever since, the silhouette of the one he cares for appears in the window.

skinCatalogue.name: Wanderer in the Rain
skinCatalogue.description: Raindrops slide down his clear umbrella to his feet, and the night wind lifts the hem of his white coat. Though the path ahead remains unclear, he knows where to go.

skinCatalogue.name: Heartwarming Baking
skinCatalogue.description: Sure, it might look a little messy, with a few things not going as planned along the way. But he will serve the cake to you with a smile all the same, just like the life he wishes to lead, one filled with an affectionate warmth.

skinCatalogue.name: Celestial Crane
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit made from high-quality Yanese brocade, accompanied with a long ribbon of gauze. At Shamare's request, the remaining fabric was used to make a new look for Morte as well.

skinCatalogue.name: Caged Singer
skinCatalogue.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will spurn not the cage but accept her shackles, so she might continue to sing.

skinCatalogue.name: Master of Melodia
skinCatalogue.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She is the Creator of the Haven, Ave Mujica . She awaits in stilled elegance, that she would entice her audience unto this world.

skinCatalogue.name: Marionette's Id
skinCatalogue.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. By her own fingers she will puppet the strings, unseal the closed box, and grant freedom to every doll.

skinCatalogue.name: Moonlight Executioner
skinCatalogue.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will carry out her mission wordlessly, so she might protect the place where she truly belongs.

skinCatalogue.name: Magician of Passion
skinCatalogue.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. For as easily as she will scry your hearts, so one can scarcely scry hers.

skinCatalogue.name: Holiday HD79
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD79. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flowers FA054
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA054. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flowers FA161
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA161. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Nuit of the Nightsky
skinCatalogue.description: Reed flutes and harps play in succession as jade lotuses gently float by. The night sky and melodic notes accompany Pepe in a moment where she has pushed everything else to the back of her mind.

skinCatalogue.name: Boundless Sail
skinCatalogue.description: Exercise attire based on a fencer's protective clothes. Offers both comfort and fashion alongside all-day defense.

skinCatalogue.name: Horus' Rest
skinCatalogue.description: Lazvar understands that even clockwork fowlbeasts occasionally need a break from yellow sands and clamorous crowds, finding a moment's rest on branches.

skinCatalogue.id: Amiya (Guard) / In A Myriad of Universes
skinCatalogue.name: In A Myriad of Universes
skinCatalogue.description: A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.

skinCatalogue.name: An Airy Dream
skinCatalogue.description: Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.

skinCatalogue.name: Quiet Move
skinCatalogue.description: He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.

skinCatalogue.name: Bustling Festival
skinCatalogue.description: Myrtle no longer cares about scoremaxxing during this grand festival, having fun drumming to the beat, rousing the audience's spirit. Don Don—KA!

skinCatalogue.name: Amongst Lotuses
skinCatalogue.description: Summer clothes inspired by lotus flowers, made for Cuora by Yanese artisans. Only after countless back-and-forths with the client did the backpack's design finally receive her approval.

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flowers FA137
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA137. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Beside Dreams
skinCatalogue.description: A sheer robe woven from Yanese muslin, paired with a magnolia hairpin. Returned to seclusion, brush in hand beside spring's window, the mortal realm meets ethereal dreams.

skinCatalogue.name: Staring into the Abyss
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Ulpianus wore when taking charge of the Abyssal Hunter Program. The consul's transformation is already complete, yet the ceremonial sword in his hand has taken on a great weight.

skinCatalogue.name: Laminar Flow
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.

skinCatalogue.name: Phototaxis
skinCatalogue.description: Ascalon's iteration from decision point F/3019226. She bids it stay for the sake of the lives of countless unbelievers, but the Seventh Sun is still determined to fall.

skinCatalogue.name: Stranded
skinCatalogue.description: Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.

skinCatalogue.name: Tidal Bore
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Lucilla wore when looking around an exhibit about extinct marine species. The eye is led down the outfit by the changes in color mimicking seawater at different depths, punctuated by unique patterns to form a calm, tranquil ensemble.

skinCatalogue.name: Whispered Longing
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Lutonada wore while taking a spring walk through Yan . An organic mixture of traditional and modern elements form a refreshing, graceful style that does not sacrifice charm. All sorts of accessories add to the cuteness.

skinCatalogue.name: Glory to the Devout
skinCatalogue.description: Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.

skinCatalogue.name: Bard by the Lake
skinCatalogue.description: Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.

skinCatalogue.name: Judgment Day
skinCatalogue.description: Gun-Knight Fiammetta returns to where her squad fell apart. Fragments of time have turned into vicious beasts, intent on bringing everything in the area into stasis. Without the slightest hesitation, she pulls the trigger.

skinCatalogue.name: A Player Forever
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Mizuki wears when he plays games in Higashi. A perfect fusion of stylish street fashion and retro game elements, letting Mizuki show off his gamer style at max settings.

skinCatalogue.name: Roar Against The Wilds
skinCatalogue.description: Młynar's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The Black Riders have finally arrived at the Forgotten Plains, but the Hermit Knight chooses not to leave. Instead, he bars the way, alone.

skinCatalogue.name: Supernova
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.

skinCatalogue.name: Melodic Flutter
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. The magnificent dress is a perfect match for the music, as the butterflies dance to the melody, bringing the reverie to life in vivid detail.

skinCatalogue.name: Radiant Serenity
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches ' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.

skinCatalogue.name: Ethereal Harmony
skinCatalogue.description: Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.

skinCatalogue.name: Golden Reverie
skinCatalogue.description: Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.

skinCatalogue.name: Empty Crown
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.

skinCatalogue.name: Plush Cake
skinCatalogue.description: On her off days, Dur-nar changes out of her well-worn battlefield clothes to try something a little more fun. She's well versed in balancing work and play, and an expert in enjoying life.

skinCatalogue.name: Sweetness to the Heart
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?

skinCatalogue.name: To Evoke the Anima
skinCatalogue.description: Sesa loves games, especially sandbox survival ones with plenty of computer-wrecking bugs. Still, with the "Garb of the Soulseer", he can overcome any issue, somehow.

skinCatalogue.name: Midskog Fika
skinCatalogue.description: Celebratory dress prepared by Valarqvin for a rare day of melted snow. Adorned with bright grass and flower motifs, which are infused with beautiful meaning in Sami .

skinCatalogue.name: Echo of Bagpipes
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.

skinCatalogue.name: Romance Overflow
skinCatalogue.description: Elaborate dress Hibiscus wore to promote a sightseeing train. Brilliant purples, beautiful hem, and delicate ornamentation—a perfect union of elegance and romance.

skinCatalogue.name: Frosted Steps
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Matoimaru wore when taking part in a period piece. An elegant Higashinese dress combined with delicate makeup bring out her hidden charms in all their glory.

skinCatalogue.name: The Ferry Girl
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Gloria wears on outings. The pink and white of the dress and the flowers complement each other. This is the ferry to the land of love, and she's waiting for you to board.

skinCatalogue.name: Sent from Ognisko
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Viviana wore on a short return trip to Ognisko, a pure linen dress paired with a knitted shawl. With these, she wanders the city of shady trees and the sounds of artisans.

skinCatalogue.name: Almond Platter
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Almond wore during a field mission in Yan . Deep crimsons are a natural complement to the festive atmosphere, while the long skirt and wide sleeves bring out her latent cuteness.

skinCatalogue.name: Prairie Pals
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Bena wore on a field mission in the prairie. The traditional clothes serving as the base have been enhanced with modern innovations, making them lightweight without sacrificing cuteness.

skinCatalogue.name: Spring Feast
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Shu wore during a feast held by her family. A beauteous purple robe across her shoulders, a silken skirt along her legs. Here, a goddess lies, quietly watching the turning of the seasons.

skinCatalogue.name: Youthful Journey
skinCatalogue.description: Outfit Zuo Le wore when using the Tianshi Bureaus' training grounds. Integrated with elements of the Tianshi gown, enabling mobility while highlighting his youthful spirit.

skinCatalogue.name: Tons of Sunshine
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.

skinCatalogue.name: Inviting Snow
skinCatalogue.description: A burdenbeast neck pillow, burdenbeast pajamas, burdenbeast slippers. A full burdenbeast ensemble, very popular in Kjerag right now!

skinCatalogue.name: All-Round Actor
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Chongyue wears when studying past roles . The characters are so different, so how should one breathe life into them? He browses both scripts and tapes, experiencing life after life after life.

skinCatalogue.name: "Ride to Davistown"
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes the rookie actress Jessica wore for her audition. Whether pointing a gun at someone else or at herself, she'd immediately tear up. Director Nian was real pleased.

skinCatalogue.name: Thunderbolt Director
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes the prodigy director Nian wears on the job. Having analyzed countless classics, she channels the inspiration into her latest blockbuster: Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday.

skinCatalogue.name: Dreaming High
skinCatalogue.description: With high-grade sandbeast feed on a Rim Billiton regional audition's prize list, Ray doesn't mind taking on a new challenge.

skinCatalogue.name: Top Tier Live
skinCatalogue.description: Always with a shining smile, a gentlemanly attitude, and impressive skills. Only just on stage, and Tequila's already mesmerized the crowd.

skinCatalogue.name: Ignis Fatuus
skinCatalogue.description: A gift for Lessing from some young Liches , for taking the brunt of their teacher 's ire. Though it's the opposite of his usual style, he looks surprisingly cool in it.

skinCatalogue.id: Executor the Ex Foedere / Allmind As One
skinCatalogue.name: Allmind As One
skinCatalogue.description: A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law : connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.

skinCatalogue.id: Texas the Omertosa / Il Segreto Della Notte
skinCatalogue.name: Il Segreto Della Notte
skinCatalogue.description: A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.

skinCatalogue.name: Diversity Oneness
skinCatalogue.description: A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.

skinCatalogue.id: Warmy / Warm Velvet At the Corner
skinCatalogue.name: Warm Velvet At the Corner
skinCatalogue.description: A warm coat, both thick and lightweight, winter boots for icy, snow-laden roads, and a white knit cap complete with a bright bow. Proof you don't have to sacrifice warmth for cuteness.

skinCatalogue.name: Starry Night Sky
skinCatalogue.description: He plays the role of the guide showing the hero the way. The Golden Movement has long since faded, but the stars he shoots will forever point true north.

skinCatalogue.name: Explosive Blue Flame
skinCatalogue.description: She plays the role of the hero seeking the grimoire said to have been born amidst the Everlasting Flame. Whichever brave soul claims it can break through all rules and bindings.

skinCatalogue.id: Degenbrecher / The Shadow of the Dark Moon
skinCatalogue.name: The Shadow of the Dark Moon
skinCatalogue.description: She plays the role of the witch guarding the grimoire. The tome is of no use to her. Instead, it is her sword that renders her unstoppable: 'Come, try to defeat me.'

skinCatalogue.name: Witch's Swing
skinCatalogue.description: She plays the role of the young witch brought by her dark mistress to gain some experience! Who says a witch's swing has to be a broom? A chainsaw works too!

skinCatalogue.id: Irene / The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve
skinCatalogue.name: The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve
skinCatalogue.description: A "Destiny Quest" outfit made for Irene by the devs based on her role in the game. To promote the next update, she's forced to stand on the stage for a photo op.

skinCatalogue.id: Kroos the Keen Glint / The Apprentice and Her Aura
skinCatalogue.name: The Apprentice and Her Aura
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Kroos wore when receiving an award at a game expo. She'd just cleared some quests with her friends when she was picked as the lucky player. Wearing the dev-provided costume, she smiled widely at the camera.

skinCatalogue.id: Leizi / The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage
skinCatalogue.name: The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Leizi wore at a game expo. She plays a mysterious wandering scholar with a magical companion. Her dedication was praiseworthy, and she brought a true ending to the story.

skinCatalogue.name: Terra & Traveller
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Marcille wears when telling stories of her adventures aboard Rhodes Island . She acts as she imagines the Lunatic Magician would, summoning several familiars with a wave of her hand. Some of them even look like our operators!

skinCatalogue.name: Dawnbreak
skinCatalogue.description: A product of Raythean Industries , made for mechanized combat, combining fashionable colors with punk style. Multi-purpose bandoliers ensure efficiency even in complex environments, providing absolute freedom.

skinCatalogue.id: Wind Chimes / Moon under the Pines
skinCatalogue.name: Moon under the Pines
skinCatalogue.description: Classic Yanese clothes, mixing tradition with modern craftsmanship. Wind Chimes leans against a tree, watching the moonlight shine in the water, her skirt like a shimmering ripple. What will you dream of tonight?

skinCatalogue.name: Among the Clouds
skinCatalogue.description: Garments crafted by Baizao 's master tailors, embodying Yan 's charms as envisioned by the wearer. Ptilopsis lightly plucks the strings, and heaven and earth resound with a crisp melody.

skinCatalogue.name: Holiday HD78
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD78. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

skinCatalogue.id: Reed the Flame Shadow / Summer Flower FA075
skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flower FA075
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flower Series FA075. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Shining Dew SDm09
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD11 for men. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.

skinCatalogue.name: Temperature Difference RT.RX07
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX07. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof, suitable for activities in a variety of waters.

skinCatalogue.id: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska / A Picnic Before A Long Trip
skinCatalogue.name: A Picnic Before A Long Trip
skinCatalogue.description: Bam! Everyone's become teeny-tiny, must be another one of Dolly 's pranks! Good thing the cream didn't stain her dress, because Eyjafjalla will need it for a dance of azure blue.

skinCatalogue.name: Courtyard of Neka
skinCatalogue.description: Out of curiosity, Hoederer knocks open the door to an ancient courtyard. He stands before a tranquil pond, engraving the beauty he stumbled upon into his memory.

skinCatalogue.name: Iakhu of Flows
skinCatalogue.description: In a naptime dream adorned with gold, the earth swells beneath Liz's feet, supporting a homeland. The sphere of the heavens turns above her head, spilling its golden rays upon her.

skinCatalogue.id: Poncirus / To Rest in Night Breezes
skinCatalogue.name: To Rest in Night Breezes
skinCatalogue.description: Siesta welcomes back any and all weary wanderers. Fresh-off-the-truck Ann-Maier puts on her favorite ensemble to hit the beach, taking in the quiet sands as day turns to night.

skinCatalogue.name: Sedjem
skinCatalogue.description: Weedy treads the boundary between sand and water, tracing the flow ever deeper. Is what she hears the whispers of the sea of salt, or the greetings of the sea of sand?

skinCatalogue.name: Vibrant
skinCatalogue.description: Clothes Enis wears when he's in a good mood. Specially chosen for him by his family. Close-fitting, snug and easy to move around in.

skinCatalogue.name: Sweet Jackpot
skinCatalogue.description: You can't win the sweets competition by wearing a uniform! Insider put this on before diving head-first into the bakery, and he's about to present his creation. Don't worry, the sweetness has been adjusted to suit your tastes.

skinCatalogue.name: Solo Around The World
skinCatalogue.description: The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.

skinCatalogue.name: Party In The Garden
skinCatalogue.description: The sweetest treats, the most vibrant flowers, and lots and lots and lots of bow-tie ribbons. Even after the fire , Goldenglow has never forgotten that dream.

skinCatalogue.id: Lee / Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha
skinCatalogue.name: Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha
skinCatalogue.description: Hard to imagine, but the oft-lazing-about Lee is happily wearing an apron while minding the leung cha store below the office. A hobby of his?

skinCatalogue.name: Stream Above The Clouds
skinCatalogue.description: She wakes up atop a cloud in her favorite childhood dress, surrounded by all her friends, and through her daze senses a freedom she hasn't felt in a long time—wait, why's she streaming with her phone?!

skinCatalogue.name: I Am the Tides
skinCatalogue.description: An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.

skinCatalogue.name: Fragrant Pace
skinCatalogue.description: A jacket and skirt woven by Dahuang 's weavers for the festivities, gifted to Grain Buds to wear as she wanders the fields. Around her, the wonders of nature. By her side, fine friends to be sure.

skinCatalogue.name: For the Banquet
skinCatalogue.description: Melanite once attended a banquet hosting people from across the industry. On careful consideration, she chose this gown to hide her true purpose for attending.

skinCatalogue.name: Scribing
skinCatalogue.description: The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa .

skinCatalogue.name: Habitat
skinCatalogue.description: Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit 's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.

skinCatalogue.name: Nocturne of Elysia
skinCatalogue.description: Blue Poison's iteration from decision point F/3019226. In the land of Elysia, she is the only fairy who is willing to offer a song to the toxic trees.

skinCatalogue.id: Ho'olheyak / Carriage of the Winds of Time
skinCatalogue.name: Carriage of the Winds of Time
skinCatalogue.description: Ho'olheyak's concert outfit, evoking a classical yet romantic dance. She chose the fabrics with utmost care, wrinkled for her key performance, and gilded for the years everlasting.

skinCatalogue.name: Under the Flaming Dome
skinCatalogue.description: As artillery splits the heavens, all is as it ever was. Ines arrives at the city, ready to rewrite Kazdel 's once inevitable ending of destruction.

skinCatalogue.name: Young Branch
skinCatalogue.description: Water melts glacier on its way back to the soil, while wandering leaves revisit the woods. Her origins in eternal sleep, her answers long departed. But where are they now?

skinCatalogue.name: Never-melting Ice
skinCatalogue.description: One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra . Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.

skinCatalogue.id: Skadi the Corrupting Heart / Red Countess
skinCatalogue.name: Red Countess
skinCatalogue.description: Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Confusion and impulse have begat the sole master of the Crimson Plain. With these emotions, she fashions her beloved creations.

skinCatalogue.id: Swire the Elegant Wit / Rhythmic Blocks
skinCatalogue.name: Rhythmic Blocks
skinCatalogue.description: Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.

skinCatalogue.name: Blade-cleaved Tides
skinCatalogue.description: Thorns bares his blade, and Iberia's fleet sets sail after a century of silence. A golden secret has emerged in lawless lands, and seas of sand and salt can no longer conceal its radiance.

skinCatalogue.name: New Business
skinCatalogue.description: Cement's survey consultant outfit. Snug and durable, the contrast of the hoodie and jacket brings out her vitality. She also gets herself a pair of goggles to match with them.

skinCatalogue.name: Leisure
skinCatalogue.description: The season's latest leisurewear in Columbia . Detachable straps and pouches let Corroserum show off the many delights of his spring travels.

skinCatalogue.name: Season of Travel
skinCatalogue.description: Pinecone's outfit while visiting family in Columbia . The jacket's jade trim outlines the simple dress with a vibrant aura. An unintentional pairing, yet perfect for spring.

skinCatalogue.name: Courtesy
skinCatalogue.description: Lungmen 's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.

skinCatalogue.name: Exhibition
skinCatalogue.description: Picked by Doc based on practical requirements, offering protection against wind, dust, and cold as he goes to the next place that needs him. Of that, there is never a shortage.

skinCatalogue.name: Safehouse
skinCatalogue.description: A set of clothes that Ela bought at the market. Light and comfortable, it is her favorite outfit in the safehouse. She particularly likes how the local hat looks on her.

skinCatalogue.name: Mirrormaze
skinCatalogue.description: Iana's casual outfit for her free time. She has changed into a pair of shorts, hoping that the sun here is different. Perhaps she will not need her hood.

skinCatalogue.name: Amidst the Pieces
skinCatalogue.description: Puzzle knows that he should tailor his attire to his target—one of the most efficient ways to win trust and exchange intel. When alone, however, he barely spares a thought to his appearance.

skinCatalogue.name: Dangerous Invitation
skinCatalogue.description: A graceful custom-made suit just for Arene. The stiff material is painstakingly cut to fit his youthful figure. He also personally selected the accompanying perfume.

skinCatalogue.name: Decoration
skinCatalogue.description: A cute dress Harmonie rarely wears. With its adjustable fit and flexible materials, it can accentuate the body's natural curves better than any other. The accessories are all from her beloved private collection.

skinCatalogue.name: Alighting
skinCatalogue.description: Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.

skinCatalogue.name: The Land With Me
skinCatalogue.description: Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.

skinCatalogue.name: Saturated Within Rain
skinCatalogue.description: Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.

skinCatalogue.name: Heavenly Mirage
skinCatalogue.description: Recreation of a Lungmen VIP 's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.

skinCatalogue.name: Away From Dust
skinCatalogue.description: Made by expert Yanese tailors, the stylish, narrow-sleeved robe is cool and comfortable. Jieyun wore it while visiting Yan's rivers and lakes .

skinCatalogue.name: Private Study
skinCatalogue.description: Mint's formalwear at the Victorian Institution for Higher Studies, the green waistband showing off her lines and individuality.

skinCatalogue.name: Curator
skinCatalogue.description: Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.

skinCatalogue.name: Occasionally Flushed
skinCatalogue.description: Sometimes, Lavinia will tolerate a hint of aqua between her otherwise pure black skirt and white coat.

skinCatalogue.name: Gratitude Gift
skinCatalogue.description: Always one to gift Sami specialties, he's now received a gift in return. He smiled to learn that Victorian garb went well with his tail.

skinCatalogue.name: Dance
skinCatalogue.description: The flimsy red skirt and sturdy white shawl are like flowing fire and burning snow. Shall we dance?

skinCatalogue.id: Vigil / The Other Side of Siracusa
skinCatalogue.name: The Other Side of Siracusa
skinCatalogue.description: Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?

skinCatalogue.name: Noon Twilight
skinCatalogue.description: Absinthe's former school uniform. In Ursus , students wear their uniforms while exercising, resembling a field of neatly spaced seedlings behind a plow.

skinCatalogue.name: Lances of Kaliskas
skinCatalogue.description: Ashlock's formalwear, worn when her family banished her. Traditional dress worthy of a Kazimierz knight, not entirely inappropriate on her.

skinCatalogue.name: Royal Guardswoman
skinCatalogue.description: Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.

skinCatalogue.name: W Dali
skinCatalogue.description: Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.

skinCatalogue.name: Wingbreaker
skinCatalogue.description: Texas the Omertosa's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The hunter shot down the great demon Vermithrax, but was betrayed by the Lone Wolf Emperor and banished to the barrens.

skinCatalogue.name: Hand of Destiny
skinCatalogue.description: This player shall be the will of the realm behind the story. She is neither a wicked god, nor a righteous spirit. All she does is let the players roll the dice.

skinCatalogue.name: Divine Oath
skinCatalogue.description: This player shall be the apostolic knight who takes charge in times of crisis. She is the crimson fury spilling forth from the Holy Spirit's palm, bearing the eternal burden of seeking the land of salvation.

skinCatalogue.name: The Bard's Tale
skinCatalogue.description: This player shall be the one singing ballads for the heroes of old, livening up the tavern with her ditties. Come, listen close, who stole the melody that wends through the shadow-flickering breeze?

skinCatalogue.name: Priory of Abyss
skinCatalogue.description: This player shall be the sister in black, who has saved countless adventurers' lives. The people never ask who forgets the traumas of their mundane lives for them.

skinCatalogue.name: Rainforest, Me, Rainbow
skinCatalogue.description: The waterproof, breathable fabric comes in handy for rainforest work. Lightweight, wear-resistant, and protects from the sun. Tail attachment optional.

skinCatalogue.id: Ling / Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia
skinCatalogue.name: Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia
skinCatalogue.description: Stylish and classic. The wind brushes the cliffs for a thousand years, a thousand li, brushing against the wanderer's robes, brushing into dream.

skinCatalogue.id: Qiubai / Wine-Flushed is Woods of Rime
skinCatalogue.name: Wine-Flushed is Woods of Rime
skinCatalogue.description: Wind-proof and wear-resistant with a clean, slim fit that's easy to move in. Inspired by the northwest poplar forests.

skinCatalogue.id: Nine-Colored Deer / A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time
skinCatalogue.name: A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time
skinCatalogue.description: Crossing the golden sands yet leaving nary a trace, time passes quietly along with the moon's shadow. Nine-Colored Deer meticulously counts the tracks left behind by the passing years, and thus the full moon pauses, seeking one to converse with.

skinCatalogue.name: Her Aspiration
skinCatalogue.description: The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.

skinCatalogue.name: Holiday HD61
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD61. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flowers FA317
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA317. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Beach Guard GT003
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT003. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.

skinCatalogue.id: Lunacub / Clouds Float Like Ideas of Art
skinCatalogue.name: Clouds Float Like Ideas of Art
skinCatalogue.description: Presented by the finest Yanese artisans, combining classic style with trendy spirit.

skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm74. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD26. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.

skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA394. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Summer Flowers FA062
skinCatalogue.description: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA062. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.

skinCatalogue.name: Freeland Tuneseeker
skinCatalogue.description: Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.

skinCatalogue.name: Hear the Wind Sing
skinCatalogue.description: New concept based on the theme of Wind, a collaborative work between multiple designers. The ever-present floating ribbons capture the shape of the wind.

skinCatalogue.name: The Road to Here
skinCatalogue.description: Loose-fitting coat that can envelop a young girl. The waterproof fabric makes it suitable for a rainy day.

skinCatalogue.name: There They Be
skinCatalogue.description: Saga's attire when she left P'o-shan Village , with Biteys for pockets and straw sandals. What is in the scrolls cannot be removed, but after so much time spent with oneselves, what was drawn in ink is now etched in the heart.

skinCatalogue.name: The Fruition
skinCatalogue.description: Classic black and white, with just a touch of color. No need for complex ornamentations; any flair belongs to the performer alone.

skinCatalogue.name: The Next Afternoon Tea
skinCatalogue.description: Tailored to fit snugly from lightweight hydrophobic fabric, ensuring the wearer is unhindered in water. Made to measure for Ægir residing on the land.

skinCatalogue.id: Ch'en the Holungday / Ten Thousand Mountains
skinCatalogue.name: Ten Thousand Mountains
skinCatalogue.description: Ch'en Hui-chieh entered the capital on a starry night, and left before sunrise after settling matters. She bid farewell to old friends and took a sampan down the river, the lamp on the prow crashing through the fog and night.

skinCatalogue.name: Eine Variation
skinCatalogue.description: A traditional-style gown worn by every Graf Urtica, now draped over Ebenholz's shoulders. Orders apathetically seep from the tip of the staff, piercing through the sparse ensemble of nobles.

skinCatalogue.name: Voyage of Feathers
skinCatalogue.description: Placed in charge of the props, she sets them in place, as a flock of fowlbeasts circles higher into the sky, ships sailing into the distant horizon.

skinCatalogue.name: Remnant
skinCatalogue.description: Originium has taken over the land, and what she envisioned has become a reality. She has enumerated and entrusted everything else to the others, leaving only her name as she hones her mission into a sharp blade.

skinCatalogue.name: Golden Dream
skinCatalogue.description: Lumen's casual leisure wear, tailored for elegance from lightweight materials. The sea mist has lifted, and you can now see the lighthouse without binoculars.

skinCatalogue.name: Granter of Colors
skinCatalogue.description: Roberta's work outfit. With the other operators' help and encouragement, Roberta finally found the time to design a look for herself as well.

skinCatalogue.id: Specter the Unchained / Born as One
skinCatalogue.name: Born as One
skinCatalogue.description: An engraving leaves a shadow, like two sides of a coin, or the cycle of day and night. When both are aware of their dual nature, Laurentina possesses a soul most complete, like unto the twin moons.

skinCatalogue.name: Invitation
skinCatalogue.description: A set of formalwear Harmonie wears while enjoying the afternoon in her study. The smart tailoring makes her skirt move in a beautiful curve, and the fabrics are specially chosen to hide any stray fur stuck on her clothes.

skinCatalogue.name: A Thousand Correspondences
skinCatalogue.description: A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.

skinCatalogue.name: To Effloresce Whitely
skinCatalogue.description: A gown for Victorian nobles woven with fine muslin, fragrant and supple flowers gracing the pure white skirt. A quiet elegance, delicate and sublime.

skinCatalogue.name: Paper Wing
skinCatalogue.description: White jacket on mint-green T-shirt, refreshingly cool for the summer.

skinCatalogue.name: Tsukiyoi
skinCatalogue.description: Custom-made for Mint, integrating Victorian style into traditional Higashinese garb. Comfy yet unique, it is one of Mint's favorites on festive occasions.

skinCatalogue.name: Betsushi
skinCatalogue.description: Traditional clothing of Higashi . It is meticulously crafted from high-quality fabrics, with vibrant colors and elegant patterns. The design is comfortable and warm, making it suitable for autumn outings.

skinCatalogue.name: Yukibare
skinCatalogue.description: Suzuran's outfit on a winter morning trip to the shrine. The loose-fitting sleeves protect against the wind and snow, while the pleated front adds an exotic touch.

skinCatalogue.id: Terra Research Commission / Fly Into the Street
skinCatalogue.name: Fly Into the Street
skinCatalogue.description: The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra -style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.

skinCatalogue.name: Under A Veil
skinCatalogue.description: Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.

skinCatalogue.name: Campfire Cooking Smoke
skinCatalogue.description: Warm fur coat paired with red woven scarf for an inviting sight.

skinCatalogue.name: Snowy Plains in Words
skinCatalogue.description: The layered fabric keeps the wearer warm, while the closed sleeves and pants keep the wind and snow out.

skinCatalogue.name: High Autumn
skinCatalogue.description: Designed for outdoor activities, providing extra support for the body. The comfortable and breathable fabric dries quickly.

skinCatalogue.id: Kroos the Keen Glint / Along the Corridor
skinCatalogue.name: Along the Corridor
skinCatalogue.description: Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.

skinCatalogue.name: Illumination That of Daylights
skinCatalogue.description: Made by Lungmen tailors. The gauze lining at the hem softens the lines, as does the matching white shawl.

skinCatalogue.id: Ling / It Does Wash the Strings
skinCatalogue.name: It Does Wash the Strings
skinCatalogue.description: Robe made from white cloth, with loose-fitting sleeves that reach to knee level. A lucky animal is weaved onto the skirt, inspired by a dream the client had.

skinCatalogue.id: Mulberry / Reflection That of the Moons
skinCatalogue.name: Reflection That of the Moons
skinCatalogue.description: Made by Lungmen tailors, inspired by the waterscapes of Jiangqi, the delicate cuts and soft gauze represent the reflection of the lotus in water when the moon is out.
